title: Chronic Migraine Diagnosis and Two Months of Fills at the Limit: Multiple for Quantity Limit Renewals
content:
When a quantity limit renewal on an acute migraine drug is approved under the Utilization Management Program, the multiple applied to the drug's limit rests on the most recent clinical information for the drug and the member's paid retail fills of it under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

**Rule.** A chronic migraine diagnosis (ICD-10-CM G43.701, G43.709, G43.711 or G43.719) together with paid retail fills reaching the limit both in the last month and in the month before it takes the package's maximum exception multiple, whole; a chronic migraine diagnosis without such fills in both months, or such fills in both months under another diagnosis, takes seven eighths (0.875) of it; any other member takes no change to the multiple under this rule.

**Months.** The windows end on the decision date. The last month is the fills dated after the same day of the month one month before the decision date; the month before it is the fills dated within the last two months but not the last month. A month reaches the limit when the quantities of the drug's paid retail fills dated in it add up to at least the drug's limit: 9 units for sumatriptan, 16 for Ubrelvy, 8 for Nurtec ODT.

**Diagnosis.** The diagnosis code on the most recent clinical information received for the drug.

| Chronic migraine diagnosis | Limit reached in both months | Multiple |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | whole maximum exception multiple (2.0 or 1.5, by package) |
| Yes | No | seven eighths of it (1.75 or 1.3125) |
| No | Yes | seven eighths of it (1.75 or 1.3125) |
| No | No | no change under this rule |

*Hypothetical case (decision date 12 November; Ubrelvy, limit 16):* fills of 16 on 1 November and 16 on 20 October, diagnosis G43.711 — both months reach 16, so the whole multiple applies. With the 20 October fill at 8 tablets, seven eighths applies.
